shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -6 && sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,100p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD && rg -n "non-Error|string rejection|cause|onError" src/orchestration/*.test.ts CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '260,380p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,50p' CHANGELOG.md && git branch --show-current"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"VALIDATED_BY|validated by|spec anchor|ordinal\" scripts .lore AGENTS.md --glob '*.*'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts | sed -n '1,55p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '48,72p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.nonError.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): report non-error rejections" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
